card.name: Words just before response or generator terms
card.fires_on: Short words inside oncology response criteria and radiopharmaceutical preparation text, such as 'good' in 'very good partial response', 'reach' before 'complete', and '9' in 'Tc 99m'. It also fires on 'the' or 'one' after 'from' before 'generator'.

modes.label: Technetium and generator preparation
modes.description: The digit 9 in Tc 99m, or a linking word after elution from a generator.
modes.example: Do not use Sodium Pertechnetate Tc 99m Injection USP more than 6 hours after its elution from<< the>> generator.
